Container.Name: mcp-adguard
Container.Overview: AdGuard Home MCP server (Rust) — exposes an AdGuard Home instance as MCP tools for AI agents. This repackages nicholaswilde/adguardhome-mcp-rs's own statically-linked musl release binary rather than running their published Docker image — that image is currently broken (GLIBC_2.38 not found; confirmed on 0.1.15 and 0.1.16), a mismatch between their floating builder and pinned distroless runtime stages. Source: mcp/adguard-gateway in this repo's sibling project, built by GitHub Actions on every push. IMPORTANT — this server speaks the OLDER SSE transport (GET /sse for the event stream, POST /message for requests), not the streamable-HTTP /mcp endpoint the other MCP gateways use. Point clients at http://ip:port/sse with an SSE-capable MCP client config (e.g. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport sse ...`). If you run more than one AdGuard Home node (they don't sync DNS rewrites), install this template once per node under a different container name (e.g. mcp-adguard, mcp-adguard-2), changing ADGUARD_HOST/ADGUARD_HTTP_PORT/ExtraParams each time. Set ExtraParams below to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces (e.g. -p 100.101.102.103:8904:8904) — replace with your own Tailscale IP and port.

Config.Name: ADGUARD_HTTP_PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container to serve MCP on — must match the container-side port in ExtraParams
